skill.name: brainstorming
skill.description: Guides collaborative brainstorming before implementation by clarifying intent, constraints, trade-offs, design details, and documentation steps.
skill.summary: Turn early ideas into validated feature designs and implementation-ready plans.
skill.author: Cygnusfear

security_audit.summary: The single static finding is a false positive. SKILL.md line 38 uses backticks for a Markdown file path, not Ruby or shell execution. I found no evidence of prompt injection, data exfiltration, network behavior, or malicious intent.

finding_verdicts.reason: SKILL.md line 38 contains a Markdown code span for the document path docs/plans/YYYY-MM-DD-<topic>-design.md. It is not executable Ruby, shell syntax, or a command injection vector.

content.value_statement: Teams often start implementation before requirements and trade-offs are clear. This skill guides Claude, Codex, or Claude Code through focused questions, options, validation, and design documentation.
actual_capabilities: Prompts review of project files, docs, and recent commits before ideation.
Compares two or three approaches with trade-offs and a recommendation.
Structures designs around architecture, components, data flow, errors, and testing.
Validates design sections incrementally before moving forward.
Directs creation of a design document after user validation.
limitations: It is prompt-only and does not include executable automation.
Quality depends on project access, user answers, and available context.
Referenced companion skills may not be installed in every environment.
Generated designs still need stakeholder and technical review.

use_cases.title: Define a New Feature
use_cases.description: Clarify goals, constraints, success criteria, and viable implementation options before engineering starts.

use_cases.title: Compare Technical Approaches
use_cases.description: Evaluate multiple designs with trade-offs, risks, and a recommended path for a planned change.

use_cases.title: Prepare an Implementation Plan
use_cases.description: Convert an early idea into a validated design document that can guide focused build work.

prompt_templates.title: Clarify a Feature Idea
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the brainstorming skill to help me turn this feature idea into a clear design: [describe idea]. Start by asking one question.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Implementation Options
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the brainstorming skill to explore two or three approaches for [planned change]. Include trade-offs and your recommended option.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a User Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the brainstorming skill to design a user workflow for [user goal]. Clarify constraints, edge cases, and success criteria first.

prompt_templates.title: Validate a System Design
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the brainstorming skill to refine this system design before implementation: [summarize design]. Review architecture, data flow, error handling, and tests.

output_examples.input: I want to add saved filters to our dashboard.
output: The assistant asks which user problem saved filters should solve first.
It compares scoped filters, shared filters, and user-specific presets.
It drafts a design covering storage, UI behavior, edge cases, and tests.

output_examples.input: We need a better onboarding flow for new workspace admins.
output: The assistant clarifies target users, activation goals, and current friction.
It proposes several workflow options with operational trade-offs.
It validates each design section before writing the final plan.

output_examples.input: I have an architecture idea but want to check risks before building.
output: The assistant reviews known context and asks focused questions.
It evaluates architecture, data flow, failures, and testing concerns.
It captures the validated decisions in a design document outline.

best_practices: Provide goals, constraints, users, and examples before asking for a design.
Answer each clarification question fully before moving to the next topic.
Ask for trade-offs, risks, and validation checkpoints before implementation.
anti_patterns: Requesting many unrelated features in one brainstorming session.
Treating the generated design as final without stakeholder review.

faq.question: What does this skill do?
faq.answer: It guides an assistant through structured brainstorming, option comparison, design validation, and design documentation.

faq.question: Does it write production code?
faq.answer: No. It focuses on requirements, design decisions, planning, and documentation before implementation.

faq.question: Can I use it with an existing codebase?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill asks the assistant to review current files, docs, and recent commits when available.

faq.question: Does it require other skills?
faq.answer: No. It can work alone, but it references companion writing, worktree, and planning skills when available.

faq.question: What output should I expect?
faq.answer: Expect focused questions, recommended approaches, design sections, validation checkpoints, and a design document path.

faq.question: Is this safe for sensitive projects?
faq.answer: Use normal review practices. Share only context that your assistant environment is allowed to access.
